product_overview: ADScale is an AI-powered creative production platform for marketing teams that need to turn campaign inputs into reviewable static ad variations quickly. It helps users generate, review, export, and reuse ad creatives while preserving brand consistency across workspaces.
core_goals: Create and manage ad campaigns with structured briefs and assets
Generate static ad creative variations from campaign inputs
Review, approve, reject, and refine generated creatives
Export approved creatives and delivery packages
Manage workspace settings, billing, and account preferences
Accept workspace invitations and collaborate within a shared workspace

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can sign in, register, recover access to their account, and join a workspace through an invitation.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Switch to the magic link flow -> Enter email -> Request a sign-in link -> See confirmation that the link was sent
Navigate to /signup -> Fill in the registration form -> Submit the sign-up form -> See the account creation result or next-step message
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter email -> Request a password reset email -> See confirmation that the reset email was sent
Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter the reset token details -> Set a new password -> See confirmation that the password was updated
Navigate to /invite -> Enter or open the invitation token -> Accept the workspace invitation -> See the workspace access result

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Authenticated users can view workspace summary metrics and recent activity from the home dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View dashboard stats and recent activity -> Open a linked workspace section such as campaigns or settings
Navigate to / -> Review workspace summary cards -> Use the workspace navigation to continue into campaign management

features.name: Campaign Management
features.description: Users can browse campaigns, create new ones, and open campaign detail pages to manage creative work.
user_flows: Navigate to /campaigns -> Browse the campaign list -> Open an existing campaign -> See campaign details, assets, and creative tools
Navigate to /campaigns -> Start creating a campaign -> Fill in the campaign brief fields -> Submit the campaign creation form -> See the new campaign appear in the workspace
Navigate to /campaigns/new -> Enter campaign information -> Provide the required brief details -> Submit the form -> Be taken into the newly created campaign flow
Navigate to /campaigns/[id] -> Review campaign content -> Continue into assets, derivations, or AI-assisted creative tools
Navigate to /campaigns -> Filter or scan campaigns -> Choose a campaign to work on -> Resume editing or review

features.name: Workspace Library and Templates
features.description: Users can access shared workspace assets and browse available templates for reuse in campaign work.
user_flows: Navigate to /library -> Browse workspace assets -> Open an asset for reuse in a campaign
Navigate to /templates -> Browse the template gallery -> Select a template to guide campaign creation or creative work
Navigate to /library -> Review stored assets -> Reuse a previously uploaded asset in a new creative workflow

features.name: Creative Restyling
features.description: Users can use the restyling tool to adapt creative assets into new visual directions.
user_flows: Navigate to /restyling -> Provide the required creative inputs -> Run the restyling workflow -> See the generated restyled result
Navigate to /restyling -> Upload or choose source material -> Start the restyling action -> Review the transformed creative output

features.name: Workspace Settings and Billing
features.description: Authenticated users can manage account settings, workspace configuration, and subscription-related actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Switch between account, workspace, billing, and plans tabs -> Review the current configuration -> Update the relevant settings
Navigate to /settings -> Open the billing or plans section -> Review available subscription options -> Start the checkout flow
Navigate to /settings -> Open the billing section -> Launch the customer portal flow -> See the external billing management experience

features.name: Public Share View
features.description: Anyone with a valid share token can open a public view of shared derivations.
user_flows: Navigate to /share/[token] -> Open the shared link -> View the published derivation content

features.name: Legal and Policy Pages
features.description: Users can view the product's terms of service and privacy policy from public pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /terms -> Read the terms of service
Navigate to /privacy -> Read the privacy policy
